source_boundary: Archive catalogue facts are not authenticated original bytes, actual postal delivery, uptake by the press, independent audience effects or hostile purpose.
original_attribution: Global Climate Coalition and John Shlaes originally authored GCC letters; distinct newspaper authors own articles; Nicky Sundt's preserved collection is catalogued by Climate Files/Climate Investigations Center. DASHI claims only the typed evidentiary comparison.

objects.claim_scope: Archive identifies an executive-director 'Dear Journalist' mailing with profiles and press material.

Archive identifies a GCC 10 March 1993 release about natural warming, models and the National Action Plan; no full original passage certified. Predates May/June reporter chain; not evidence of recipient exposure or effect.
Archive identifies a GCC letter addressed to reporters and enclosure of a GCC press release and two separately authored newspaper articles.
Archive describes a letter to DOE Deputy Assistant Secretary Abe Haspel, referring to a prior meeting; archival claim about a meeting is not an independently authenticated participation record.
Archive describes a letter from John Shlaes to White House Chief of Staff Thomas F. McLarty, copied to interagency groups.
Archive holds original newspaper clippings with different bylines and article publication dates; archive possession does not establish GCC placement of or causal influence on the independent stories.

negative_controls: Never identify the attached newspaper articles with GCC-authored documents.
Do not treat catalogue dates as independently certified dispatch/receipt.
Do not attribute the separate April 1998 API proposed plan as the cause of a 1993 activity.
Do not promote archive possession to independently corroborated publication influence.
Do not classify agency communication or policy disagreement as hostile warfare without independent evidence.
GCC March 10 1993 modelling release predates June original newspaper and response; June response is not the first recorded GCC climate-modelling communication.
